name: metabase
description: Read and write any Metabase instance through the official Metabase MCP server. List databases, tables, fields, questions, and dashboards; run saved questions; execute ad-hoc SQL or MBQL queries; create and update questions, dashboards, and cards; export results as CSV, JSON, or XLSX.

interface.shortDescription: Query and manage a Metabase instance through the official Metabase MCP server.
interface.longDescription: The Metabase skill exposes the official metabase-mcp-server as a single Fractal toolset. It lets the agent list databases, tables, fields, questions, and dashboards on any Metabase instance; search the data model; run saved questions with parameters; execute ad-hoc SQL or MBQL queries against a connected warehouse; create and update questions, dashboards, and dashboard cards; and export results as CSV, JSON, or XLSX. Authentication uses either a Metabase API key (recommended) or a username / password pair. Defaults to read-only-friendly behavior: search before listing, prefer saved questions over ad-hoc SQL, default to LIMIT 1000, and require explicit user confirmation before any write or archive.
defaultPrompt: Use the Metabase skill whenever the task involves querying, inspecting, or modifying content in a Metabase instance.
Prefer `search` over `list_*` calls to avoid scanning every database, table, or field on a large warehouse.
Prefer `run_question` over `execute_query` for known questions — saved questions are version-controlled and respect author permissions.
Use the Metabase API key (`METABASE_API_KEY`) instead of a username / password whenever a key is available.
